brief:
The Gaza conflict is reshaping cultural attitudes on Broadway, with growing calls for artists to declare positions on Palestinian rights, Middle East Eye reported. Despite increased industry focus on Palestinian causes, Palestinian performers themselves remain underrepresented in theatre spaces.

The pressure on cultural figures reflects broader divisions over the conflict's impact on artistic freedom and political expression within the entertainment sector.

title: Gaza war pressures Broadway artists to take political stance
